$comment: SCRUM-37. Enforced on every pull request by `pnpm check:lighthouse` (scripts/lighthouse-budget.mjs) against the built site, in Lighthouse's mobile emulation (Moto G Power, simulated slow 4G). Scores are 0-100 minimums; metrics and sizes are strict upper limits; each page is run `runs` times and the median is judged.

home.$comment: Weight limits for the landing page ('/') only: transferred (compressed) bytes.

structure.$comment: What a score cannot show. maxRenderBlocking: <head> requests the page must wait for before it can paint or run script (today the site stylesheet and /env.css; a third one fails). maxRequests: whole page. sameOriginOnly keeps fonts and everything else self-hosted (the Content-Security-Policy is 'self').
